title: Pointwise invertibility of the forgotten native adjunction unit mate
statement: Let k₀, ℓ, X, native models M, comparison η with NativeHomRepresentativeCompatibility hη, ordinary CoefficientClosedStructure S, symmetry β, canonical-monoidal equality hmonoidal and NativeOrdinaryTensorModels hS be as in lem-sf-native-weil-tensor-adjoints. Fix K and ANY functor L with adjunction a:L ⊣ M.weilHom(K,-). For every A, the arrow uncurry_S(F(a.unit_A) ≫ η_(K,L(A))) : S.tensor(F(A),F(K)) → F(L(A)), where F=nativeForget, is an isomorphism. No adjoint existence, tensor bifunctor or natural transformation is asserted.

source.place: Internal-Hom comparison and transposition paragraph; adjoint construction and invertibility of the unit mate in native tensor lift steps 1--2. Stacks 06YS, 08J9 and 0A97.

proof.text: Apply native_weil_ringed_tensor_model to the prescribed ordinary model S, beta, hmonoidal and hS. Obtain W, tensor comparison t, projection-normalized chi and the equation identifying t inverse with the unit mate of W.adjunction. The geometric construction is reused rather than repeated.
Apply native_hom_representative_unique to hEta and hChi for the same M, obtaining eta=chi. Substitute this equality.

Let e=(W.adjunction K).leftAdjointUniq a. Its unit compatibility rewrites a.unit as the canonical unit followed by M.weilHom(identity,e.hom). Apply forgetting and naturality of chi. Naturality in the target of inverse ordinary transposition then identifies the requested mate with t.inv.app(A,K) followed by nativeForget.map(e.hom.app A). Both factors are isomorphisms, so their composite is an isomorphism. These are Mathlib Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app and homEquiv_naturality_right_symm.

proof_origin.place: Reuse the existing normalized action-site tensor model; identify its Hom comparison by representative uniqueness and transport the unit mate along Mathlib leftAdjointUniq. Explicit naturality calculation by Y8.

mathlib_searches.query: Left adjoint to fixed-source derived internal Hom on modules on a ringed site using K-flat resolutions and K-injective representatives
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: sheaf module pullback and sheafification adjunctions, free module adjunctions and LightCondensed closedness. None constructs an adjoint for the specified native unbounded derived Hom or proves the normalized forgetful mate invertible. Local source search found tensorIhomAdjunction and tensorHomAdjunctionQhObj, but no native monoidal/flat-resolution interface to specialize them directly.

Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Mates provides conjugateEquiv, its identity/composition laws, and its unit/counit equations. The parametrized-adjunction file explicitly leaves assembly from pointwise adjoints as a TODO. These supply formal glue, implemented and proved in the parent module, but neither geometric pointwise assertion.

Five Mathlib hits: unit_mateEquiv and related formal equations. Local rg for hom_isRightAdjoint, mate_isIso, pointwise adjoint and unit_mate found no matching native statement. Whole-blueprint searches: tensor adjoint has no exact phrase match; unit mate has two unrelated exchange-map nodes (fix-lem-exchanges and lem-weil-pbc-transport-identifies-exchange).

theorem native_weil_unit_mate_isIso
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    (M : NativeClosedHomModels k₀ l X)
    (η : M.weilHom ⋙ nativeForget k₀ l X ≅
      (nativeForget k₀ l X).op.prod (nativeForget k₀ l X) ⋙ M.ordinaryHom)
    (hη : NativeHomRepresentativeCompatibility (ihomBifunctor k₀ l X)
      (ordinaryIhomBifunctor l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber)
      M.weilHom M.ordinaryHom M.weilRepresentatives M.ordinaryRepresentatives
      (Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)) η)
    (S : CoefficientClosedStructure M.ordinaryHom)
    (β : @SymmetricCategory _ _ S.monoidal)
    (hmonoidal : S.monoidal = (inferInstance : MonoidalCategory
      (DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber))))
    (hS : NativeOrdinaryTensorModels l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber
      M.ordinaryHom M.ordinaryRepresentatives S β)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X))
    (L : DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X))
    (a : L ⊣ Prod.sectR (op K) _ ⋙ M.weilHom)
    (A : DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X)) :
    IsIso ((S.transpose ((nativeForget k₀ l X).obj A) ((nativeForget k₀ l X).obj K)
      ((nativeForget k₀ l X).obj (L.obj A))).symm
        ((nativeForget k₀ l X).map (a.unit.app A) ≫ η.hom.app (op K, L.obj A)))
